features.label: Head sweeps
features.definition: Swings of at least 30 degrees per valid on-platform minute. Whole checking session.

features.label: Departures
features.definition: Observed departures of at least 1 second. Gaps can leave departures unobserved.

features.label: Swimming time
features.definition: Observed off-platform time over the 120-second checking session.

features.label: Swim speed
features.definition: Median smoothed off-platform speed; requires at least 1 second of observed swimming.

features.label: Near old location
features.definition: Percentage of observed swimming time within 20 cm of proposed P1; no visit dwell requirement.

features.label: Near wall
features.definition: Percentage of observed swimming time beyond 0.85 pool radii.

features.label: Round trips
features.definition: Fully observed departure-to-return paths; gaps or trial end censor unfinished paths.

features.label: Trips reaching P1
features.definition: Complete round trips with any off-platform entry within 20 cm of P1; no minimum dwell time. Zero if no complete trips were observed.

features.label: Trips reaching P1
features.definition: Trips reaching P1 divided by complete round trips. Undefined when there are no complete trips.

features.label: Later P1 trips
features.definition: Complete trips reaching P1 after the first such complete trip. A lower-bound count, not within-trip reentries or a diagnosis.

features.label: Round-trip duration
features.definition: Median departure-to-placement-return duration among complete round trips. Undefined with no complete trip.

features.label: Day 5 latency
features.definition: Corrected AnyMaze mean escape latency on Day 5. Trials have a 30-second cap; this is not pure memory accuracy.

features.label: Day 1 minus Day 5
features.definition: Difference between daily mean escape latencies; positive means a shorter latency on Day 5.

features.label: Day 7 minus Day 5
features.definition: Change in mean latency; positive means longer on Day 7. Day 7 occurs after Day 6 checking and is not a baseline predictor of it.

format: float64-le x4 per frame, followed by uint8 flags
geometry_status: Provisional; brief specifies 172.5 cm. No rescaling applied.
p1_status: Assumed camera correspondence in KAC; reflected placement in SP1. Registration pending.
